Name: Medieval Winery
Author: DoctorDDub
Description:
Do you love the winery building that Sauvignon in Stardew adds? Do you also love building mods and map recolors that end up making the thing stick out like a sore (but beautiful) thumb? Me too.

This is my first ever mod that I've created, and after spending as much time on it as I did, I figured I might as well share it with others that might get some joy out of using it. I hope you enjoy :)

[b][u]This mod includes:[/u]
[/b][list]
[*]Seasonal variations of the winery's exterior
[*]An overhauled interior with all new textures, including the addition of the massive kegs (purely decorative) that seem to be non-functional in the original mod
[/list]
[b][u]Installation Instructions[/u]
[/b]Extract/unzip the folder, then copy and paste the contents into the SauvignoninStardew/assets folder and "Replace the files in the destination" when prompted. DO NOT simply copy this into your Mods folder - it will not work. If you want to revert back to the original look, instead of overwriting those files, rename the original files in the SauvignoninStardew/assets folder before dragging and dropping these into the folder. 

[b][u]Related/Required Mods
[/u][/b]This is designed to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2597]Sauvignon in Stardew[/url]﻿ by Jesse (aka Jdvicks94). Unfortunately, that mod seems to be abandoned, but luckily there is an [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-4.156000/page-21#post-3353940]Unofficial Update for Sauvignon in Stardew[/url]﻿ that you will need in order for this mod to work.

I designed this specifically to pair with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1451]Seasonal Custom Farm Buildings[/url]﻿, but it pairs beautifully with some of Gwen's (aka Gweniaczek) incredibly popular mods as well, such as:

[center][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings - CP[/url]﻿﻿[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5301]Fish Ponds - 3 Options - CP[/url]﻿﻿
and for those of you SVE fans:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6086]Medieval SV Expanded[/url]﻿﻿﻿[/center]
[b][u]Known Issues
[/u][/b]The right portion of the building (right of the archway) lacks collision and a shadow in front of it. This is an issue with the base mod itself and not my retexture. I have no fix for the shadow, but you can fix the collision by just placing fence posts behind the right side of the building! Boom. You're welcome.

[b][u]Shameless Plug[/u]
[/b]I specifically designed this mod for use with my current modded play through of SDV over on YouTube. You can check that out here, if interested: [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLtzmcqc9dXTfZn4it3NT3a6CuRvJEXwA_]Modded SDV Let's Play[/url]﻿

[b][u]Special Thanks[/u]
[/b]Huge thanks goes out to Gwen (Gweniaczek) for her help with this, from giving second opinions, offering advice, to her talents at finding rogue pixels. She truly has a gift. Go check out her mods - they're all pretty dang incredible!!!
